title: The Surface You Test Is Not the Surface That Breaks
abstract: arXiv:2605.30454v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prompt-injection benchmarks for LLM agents typically test attacks through a single injection surface and report the resulting attack success rate as a property of the model. We ask whether those robustness conclusions remain stable when the same adversarial content enters through a different part of the agent interface. Using AgentDojo, we evaluate 13 LLMs across four task suites and place a byte-identical payload either in a tool output or in the tool description. This small change produces large differences in comparative robustness: 44.9% of all model pairs change their relative ordering across the two surfaces, with substantial ranking instability in every suite. The effect is especially pronounced for a small number of models, showing that a benchmark can substantially underestimate vulnerability when it tests only one surface. translated_title: 你测试的攻击面并非真正被攻破的攻击面
translated_abstract: 针对大语言模型（LLM）智能体的提示注入基准测试通常仅通过单一注入面来测试攻击，并将由此得到的攻击成功率报告为模型本身的一种属性。我们探究的问题是：当相同的对抗性内容通过智能体接口的不同部分进入时，这些鲁棒性结论是否依然稳定。基于AgentDojo，我们在四个任务套件上评估了13个LLM，并将字节完全相同的载荷分别放置在工具输出或工具描述中。这一微小的改动带来了比较鲁棒性上的巨大差异：44.9%的模型对在两种注入面之间改变了相对排序，且在每个任务套件中都存在显著的排名不稳定现象。该效应在少数模型上尤为突出，这表明仅测试单一注入面的基准测试可能会严重低估模型的脆弱性。我们进一步发现，这种行为具有可预测的结构：利用三个套件来识别……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 仅将字节完全相同的提示注入载荷从工具输出移动到工具描述中，就会使44.9%的模型对的鲁棒性相对排序发生改变，表明只测试单一注入面的基准测试会严重低估LLM智能体的真实脆弱性。
en_tdlr: Placing a byte-identical prompt-injection payload in a tool description instead of a tool output flips the relative robustness ranking of 44.9% of LLM pairs, showing that single-surface benchmarks can substantially underestimate agent vulnerability.
